content.short: WalletConnect is the Web3 middleware infrastructure linking DApps with wallets.
content.description: WalletConnect, founded by Pedro Gomes in 2018, is one of the leading wallet infrastructures in Web3. If a DApp does not directly support a wallet, users can log in through WalletConnect. The platform also assists developers with Web3 frontend and wallet compatibility, helping streamline integration across diverse wallets and DApps. To date, WalletConnect has been integrated with more than 170 wallets and 450 DApps.
